messages:
Lina: Heads-up — encountered weird duplicated tokens + parse errors in the node sample-streamer when refresh kicks in mid-stream. Repro on staging behind our nginx-ish proxy.
Devon: Can you paste the minimal trace? Which SDK + polyfill?
Lina: node-sdk v2.3 wrapped with eventsource-polyfill. Trace: 
```
2026-03-21T09:05:02Z STREAM_START id=xyz-789
2026-03-21T09:06:10Z AUTH_WARN token_expiring
2026-03-21T09:06:11Z RECONNECT open new_conn
2026-03-21T09:06:11Z CHUNK recv:"data: {\"delta\": \"Hel"
2026-03-21T09:06:11Z CHUNK recv:"lo\"}\n"
2026-03-21T09:06:11Z PARSE_ERR unexpected end of input
```
App UI shows 'HelloHello' sometimes.
Karim: Sounds like two issues: (A) we reopen the SSE without Last-Event-ID so server can re-send a window; (B) client parser tries to JSON.parse partial payloads if boundaries are split.
Lina: My quick hack buffered until a full SSE event terminator (\n\n) and then JSON.parse — reduced crashes but duplicates persisted.
Devon: Right — de-dupe by event id should be the canonical defence. Server emits an 'id: <event-id>' per message; on reconnect client should set 'Last-Event-ID: <last_received_id>' header so server can avoid re-sending. And client should ignore events with ids <= last_seen_id.
Karim: Agree. Also proxies may inject CRLF/CR only or merge TCP segments. Parser must not assume each 'data:' block is a full JSON object. Implement incremental JSON builder: accumulate 'data:' lines for an event, then attempt to parse only when event terminator seen. If parse fails, keep buffering until complete. Don't throw on partial parse.
Lina: We also saw a case where the polyfill emitted 'message' events with fragmented data callbacks that made the wrapper try to parse twice. Maybe add a small de-dupe queue in SDK keyed by id + short TTL.
Devon: Suggestion for sample apps/docs: add a section 'Handling long-lived SSE streams' covering: token refresh strategies, Last-Event-ID, recommended id format (monotonic/uuid), and a note about proxies. And include a tiny repro script that forces a mid-stream refresh.
Karim: For DX: set dev tokens' TTL < 60s in quickstarts? That might surprise people. Better: show how to implement soft-refresh where client asks for a new token before expiry and attaches it with Last-Event-ID on reconnect.
Lina: I can PR a sample-app change to show the soft-refresh approach + add an e2e that simulates chunk splitting using a tiny TCP proxy (we used mitmproxy script).
deploy-bot: CI: sample-apps/staging build queued — sse-reorder-test pending.
Devon: We'll also need SDK changes: (1) defensive buffering in node-sdk's SSE parser, (2) attach Last-Event-ID header when reconnecting after non-fatal auth 401, (3) id-based client-side de-dup cache with small sliding window, (4) tolerate CR vs CRLF.
Karim: I'll prototype the parser changes — will include unit tests that feed interleaved chunks and CRLF variants. Lina, can you add a manual repro snippet to the sample-app issue?
Lina: Yup — posting the snippet in the issue now. Also adding note to quickstart: "If you see duplicated tokens during reconnect, implement Last-Event-ID + client id de-dup."
QA: Adding regression test to sse-integration-suite: mid-chunk auth refresh + simulated proxy chunk reorder.
Lina: Thanks all. Assigning follow-ups: @Karim for SDK parser, @Devon for headers/refresh behavior, @Lina for sample-app docs and e2e. Ping if you want the mitmproxy rule I used. :wave:
